What Are Altcoins?

• Altcoins = Bitcoin's alternatives, with unique features & use cases.
• Ethereum = smart contracts, DeFi.
• Litecoin = faster transactions, different mining.
• Solana = high-speed, low-cost transactions.
• Dogecoin = meme-inspired, community-driven.
